WITH state_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.state_county_province,
        SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft
    JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
    JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
    SELECT
        state_county_province,
        total_amount,
        total_amount / SUM(total_amount) OVER () AS share
    FROM state_totals
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM state_shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ss.total_amount) AS combined_transaction_total,
    AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
    AVG(ss.share - av.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM state_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
WHERE ss.share > av.avg_share
